user_input: What is the procedure when an act of indiscipline occurs in academic premises?
reference: The person witnessing the incident should intervene, the matter is reported to the Office of Student Affairs (OSA), which convenes a committee comprising members of the Disciplinary Committee for enquiry.
reference_contexts: Standard operating procedure for handling acts of indiscipline Academic premises 1. If a student is found indulging in any act of indiscipline, the person witnessing the incident should intervene... The OSA will convene a committee comprising members of the Disciplinary Committee

user_input: Who issues the formal punishment order following a disciplinary enquiry and who receives copies?
reference: Based on recommendations of the inquiry committee, the Professor of Student Welfare issues the formal punishment order. Copies are shared with parents, school/department heads, class advisors, Chief Warden, and security.
reference_contexts: Based on the recommendations of the inquiry committee, the Professor of Student Welfare will issue a formal punishment order. Copy of the order will be shared with parents, school/department heads of the student, class advisors, Chief Warden, hostel, and security manager.

user_input: What immediate action is taken if there is prima facie evidence of narcotics use or handling?

reference_contexts: Use of Narcotics If there is prima face evidence in the use/handling/smuggling of Narcotics, the student to be suspended pending enquiry and asked to vacate the Hostel immediat3ely Enquiry committee to be constituted... Police immediately. Parents also to be informed.
